Sandbox_SilencerSoundReduction_tooltip: Percentage reduction applied to sound radius and sound volume when a Silencer is attached. 0 means no sound reduction; 100 means silent.
Sandbox_SilencerRangeReduction_tooltip: Flat amount subtracted from maximum range when a Silencer is attached.
Sandbox_SilencerDurability_tooltip: Number of shots the Silencer can survive. Each shot consumes 1 condition; at 0 condition it no longer suppresses firearm noise.
